citations.field: PDF p.708, printed p.695; headword 幫(帮) and explanation
citations.text: The entry is headed 幫(帮), gives the paired reading bāng, and calls 幫 a phonosemantic character formed from 帛 with 封 as phonetic. It gives the original sense as the edge of a shoe; cites 集韻·唐韻 “帮，治履边也”; then describes extensions to raised sides of objects, assistance, groups, and a classifier. It says 帮 had appeared by the modern period as a俗字 of 幫, formed by simplifying the lower 帛 component to 巾. This is the book author’s analysis, not a dated first attestation or a documented step-by-step history. The scan’s printed page number 695 is visible. The entry and its continuation are on p.708; p.709 begins other entries. Checked the visible headword, component clause, sense discussion, and simplification statement against the supplied scan pixels.
